description: The pie chart represents the distribution of data entries across various task categories within a dataset. There are seven categories depicted in the chart. The largest slice represents Math with 29.3% of the entries, followed by Coding at 24.3%, and Information Seeking at 22.2%. Reasoning accounts for 10.4% of the entries, while Planning and Creative Writing each make up 2.3% and 2.2% respectively. The remaining entries are categorized under Others combined, which comprises 9.3% of the total. Each slice is labeled with the category name and the corresponding percentage. The chart includes a legend that matches the colors of the slices to their respective categories. The percentages are also displayed inside the slices, and the chart is not visually emphasized in any particular way.
